name: knoter-web
description: React Electron-style workspace template with panes, tabs, command palette, floating windows, and movable bars.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/prepare-test-build.cjs && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.electron:hint: node -e "console.log('Use Vite dev URL in development, then load dist/index.html in Electron production builds.')"
